items.name: dispatch-truck-button

items.name: face-scan-pay-button

items.name: orbit-dot-export-button

items.name: shredder-delete-button

items.name: cloud-launch-publish-button

items.name: radial-share-menu

items.name: skeleton-wave-shimmer

items.name: list-bloom-shimmer
items.title: List Bloom Shimmer

items.name: cook-loading
items.title: Cook Loading
items.description: An illustrated chef stirs a sizzling wok while your app loads — eight original cooking poses, drifting steam, real progress and ready/error states in one self-contained component.

items.name: hourglass-loader
items.title: Hourglass Loader
items.description: A brass-and-glass hourglass: sand drains from the upper bulb through a trickling stream into a growing mound, and in endless mode the glass turns itself over on a spring when the top runs dry. Pass progress for a determinate progressbar.

items.name: orbital-bead-loader
items.title: Orbital Bead Loader
items.description: Beads orbit a core; hover speeds up.

items.name: ink-drip-loader

items.name: morph-glyph-loader
items.title: Morph Glyph Loader
items.description: Glyph morphs through abstract SVG shapes.

items.name: liquid-charge-capsule
items.title: Liquid Charge Capsule
items.description: A glass capsule with a two-layer sloshing liquid that rises to the charge level. Colour warms from ember red to calm emerald as it fills, bubbles rise and pop while charging, a brushed-metal bolt floats in the glass and a soft pulse celebrates a full charge.

items.name: ghost-gobbler-skull
items.title: Ghost Gobbler Skull
items.description: A glossy vinyl-toy skull that tracks little black-smoke ghosts drifting in from every direction, drops its jaw, slurps each one in like spaghetti and CHOMPS — then levels up: glowing eyes, blush, cracks of light, star catchlights, orbiting embers, flames and finally a crown with a smoke-ring burp. Works as a determinate or endless loader, an async task wrapper with a sad dizzy failure, or an idle mascot.

items.name: particle-morph-loader
items.title: Particle Morph Loader
items.description: A depth-lit swarm of motes spins in 3D and melts between sphere, ribbon, shell, tetra, ring and helix while a status word rolls underneath.

items.name: lattice-pulse-loader
items.title: Lattice Pulse Loader
items.description: 3×3 nodes pulse in a traveling wave.

items.name: snake-loader
items.title: Snake Loader
items.description: A progress loader whose visual is a tiny snake board. The snake plays itself while you wait, progress fills a row of tiles beneath it, and the status line carries the label, current step and percentage. Done offers continue; an error crashes the snake and offers a retry. Click the board and the snake is yours.

items.name: constellation-lost-404

items.description: Tiny 3D astronaut among reconnecting star “404” with pointer parallax.

items.name: snap-magnet-scroll

items.name: velocity-fade-stack

items.name: editorial-spread-card

items.name: swipe-carousel-post

items.description: An Instagram-style multi-slide post card: drag or swipe the media and the track snaps on a spring, a segmented bar fills with slide progress, the dot pager shrinks toward the edges and a double-tap drops a heart.

items.name: folder-fan-showcase
items.title: Folder Fan Showcase
items.description: Social post cards wait inside a frosted-glass folder, peeking over the rim of a blurred front pocket. Hover or focus and they rise and fan out on staggered springs; pick one and it lifts clear of the pocket and is pulled forward, with a soft mirrored reflection on the floor.

items.name: origami-unfold-card

items.name: lenticular-shift-card

items.name: curved-tile-wall

items.name: glow-leaderboard-list
items.title: Glow Leaderboard List
items.description: Glass pill rows that genuinely compete: scores tick up live, rows re-rank with layout springs, amounts roll and the glowing leader highlight glides to the new #1.

items.name: podium-stack-leaderboard
items.title: Podium Stack Leaderboard
items.description: Gold, silver and bronze cards stacked like a hand of trophies; promoting someone lifts their card past its rival, re-stacks the pile and morphs the medal finishes.

items.name: kpi-spark-widget
items.title: KPI Spark Widget
items.description: KPI number ticker with mini sparkline that draws on mount and a trend delta pill.

items.name: live-meter-dial
items.title: Live Meter Dial
items.description: Animated semicircle gauge for delivery rate / ASR / concurrent calls.

items.name: activity-stream-widget
items.title: Activity Stream Widget
items.description: Live-feeling activity feed with staggered row inserts.

items.name: status-heatmap-grid
items.title: Status Heatmap Grid
items.description: Compact hour×day heatmap for message volume with hover tooltip.

items.name: ring-progress-cluster
items.title: Ring Progress Cluster
items.description: Cluster of animated progress rings for queue depth, SLA, and capacity.

items.name: glass-bubble-buddy
items.title: Glass Bubble Buddy
items.description: A living blob mascot inside a glossy glass sphere with a tiny expression system (lids, catchlights, brows, blush, mouth) and a springy body. Idle it wanders and notices your cursor, listening it leans in and nods, thinking it ponders with orbiting sparkles, speaking it talks and jiggles — and it gets drowsy when ignored.

items.name: mesh-pill-orb
items.title: Mesh Pill Orb
items.description: A lava-lamp gradient mesh swirls inside a softly wobbling blob with two pill eyes. Idle it drifts and blinks, listening it widens and leans in, thinking it narrows and glances around under spinning orbit arcs, speaking its eyes squash into bars that bounce with the voice — while sonar rings and tiny motes breathe out from the rim.

items.name: star-morph-buddy
items.title: Star Morph Buddy
items.description: A floating indigo blob with a warm glowing core. Hover or focus and it springs into a soft five-point star — core flares, eyes tilt, cheeks blush, sparkles pop at the tips and the greeting crossfades into an intro with a gradient-inked phrase. Leave and it relaxes back on a softer spring.

items.name: call-control-bar
items.title: Call Control Bar
items.description: Mute / hold / end / keypad with glowing active states and hold pulse.

items.name: live-transcript-panel
items.title: Live Transcript Panel
items.description: Scrolling dual-speaker transcript with speaker pills and auto-scroll.

items.name: agent-state-orb
items.title: Agent State Orb
items.description: Listening / thinking / speaking orb with distinct motion modes.

items.name: voice-waveform-lane
items.title: Voice Waveform Lane
items.description: Animated audio waveform bars reacting to simulated level; latency chip.

items.name: softphone-dial-pad
items.title: Softphone Dial Pad
items.description: Stylish dial pad with ripple keys, number display, ringing call button.

items.name: queue-ticket-card
items.title: Queue Ticket Card
items.description: Call queue card with wait ticker, priority, skill tags, claim/transfer actions.

items.name: prism-mesh-orb
items.title: Prism Mesh Orb
items.description: Iridescent mesh sphere — idle/listen/speak modes, pointer tilt, equatorial voice wave when speaking.

items.name: liquid-metal-orb
items.title: Liquid Metal Orb
items.description: Mercury / liquid-metal ball with traveling highlight; morphs slightly when speaking.

items.name: aurora-core-orb
items.title: Aurora Core Orb
items.description: Inner aurora ribbons through a translucent shell; outer soft glow rings expand on listen.

items.name: particle-halo-orb
items.title: Particle Halo Orb
items.description: Core ball + orbiting particle halo that densifies with energy; demo slider or auto level.

items.name: ribbon-helix-wave
items.title: Ribbon Helix Wave
items.description: Premium dual ribbon helix / sine ribbons reacting to amplitude — best-in-class voice visualizer.

items.name: radial-sonar-wave
items.title: Radial Sonar Wave
items.description: Circular sonar / polar waveform around a center mic glyph; pulse rings on peaks.

items.name: pill-trail-cursor
items.title: Pill Trail Cursor
items.description: Pointer leaves a springing trail of word pills.

items.name: halftone-bloom-cursor
items.title: Halftone Bloom Cursor
items.description: Pointer blooms a lilac halftone matrix.

items.name: cursor-trail
items.title: Cursor Trail
items.description: Glowing trail following the pointer.

items.name: ribbon-trail-cursor
items.title: Ribbon Trail Cursor
items.description: Soft ribbon trail with springy spacing.

items.name: lens-flare-cursor
items.title: Lens Flare Cursor
items.description: Soft optical flare that lags behind the pointer.

items.name: ink-stamp-cursor
items.title: Ink Stamp Cursor
items.description: Small ink stamps that fade behind the pointer.

items.name: orbit-ring-cursor
items.title: Orbit Ring Cursor
items.description: Thin ring orbits the pointer.

items.name: morph-search-capsule
items.title: Morph Search Capsule
items.description: Compact search pill expands into a typing capsule.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: Thumb stretches elastically while dragging.

items.name: signal-pebble
items.title: Signal Pebble
items.description: Procedural noise pebble with a status verb.

items.name: signature-pad-field
items.title: Signature Pad Field
items.description: An e-signature field: draw with mouse, pen or finger and the ink thins on fast strokes and pools on slow ones; undo stroke by stroke, or switch to the Type tab for a keyboard-friendly script signature. Adopting it stamps a signed time.

items.name: tumbler-lock-otp
items.title: Tumbler Lock OTP
items.description: A one-time-code field built from combination-lock drums on real CSS-3D cylinders; each digit whirrs a full turn before landing, a padlock checks the code and springs open — or shakes and spins every drum back on failure.

items.name: crystal-strength-password
items.title: Crystal Strength Password
items.description: A password field that grows an SVG crystal: each satisfied rule springs a faceted shard out of the rock, the cluster shifts from ember to glacier, and a perfect score turns it iridescent with glints. Includes show/hide and a forged suggestion that scrambles in.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Versatile button with variants and sizes.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact status and label chips.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Composable surface with hairline ring and layered shadow; default, raised, glass and outline variants.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Accessible text field with focus ring.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Plain animated boolean switch.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with optional label.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Keyboard-friendly tabbed panels.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable sections with motion.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Accessible modal dialog.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hover/focus hint bubbles.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Action menu anchored to a trigger.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient notifications with a provider.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User image with initials fallback.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar with semantic tones, sizes, an optional label with tabular percentage, and an indeterminate mode.

items.name: breathing-dot
items.title: Breathing Dot
items.description: Soft pulsating status indicator.

items.name: dealer-deck-testimonials
items.title: Dealer Deck Testimonials
items.description: Testimonials dealt like playing cards: the top card of a face-down deck slides across the table on a spring, flips face-up mid-flight and lands slightly askew on the pile. Take one back or gather the deck.

items.name: particle-mesh-gallery
items.title: Particle Mesh Gallery
items.description: An image-colored particle sphere unfolds into a portrait on tap and gathers back on double tap, with original landscape art and a quiet project index.

items.name: kinetic-name-hero
items.title: Kinetic Name Hero
items.description: Your name set huge, every letter on its own spring — letters are pushed away, tilt and swell as the cursor passes, then ease home; a soft light trails the pointer and a badge circles the role.

items.name: spotlight-reveal-hero
items.title: Spotlight Reveal Hero
items.description: A quiet paper-and-ink hero with a cursor-lit lens that reveals a saturated, grid-drawn “lit” version of the same message; the beam wanders on its own when idle and locks onto the button on keyboard focus.

items.name: depth-parallax-hero
items.title: Depth Parallax Hero
items.description: A layered SVG landscape — sun/moon, three mountain planes and a tree line — shifting at depth-correct factors with the pointer or a slow idle sway; the giant name sits between the planes.

items.name: role-morph-hero
items.title: Role Morph Hero
items.description: “a ____.” where the blank cycles through your roles: letters of the old role drop away with a blur, the next role springs up in a stagger, the highlighter springs to the new width and a colour wash shifts.

items.name: photo-strip-hero
items.title: Photo Strip Hero
items.description: A big headline over two tilted rails of photo cards drifting in opposite directions — they slow under the pointer, surge with scroll velocity and lift on hover.

items.name: terminal-dev-hero
items.title: Terminal Dev Hero
items.description: A developer intro with a live terminal: commands type with human rhythm, outputs stream in, a build bar fills and the window floats in 3D with the pointer. Pause and replay included.

items.name: project-reveal-list
items.title: Project Reveal List
items.description: An editorial project index: rows dim their siblings and nudge on hover while a tilting preview chases the cursor on a spring and unmasks with a clip-path. Touch gets inline thumbnails.

items.name: project-filter-gallery
items.title: Project Filter Gallery
items.description: Category chips share a sliding pill (layout animation) while the grid reflows: survivors glide to new cells, newcomers bloom in blur-to-sharp. Announces the result count.

items.name: case-study-scroll
items.title: Case Study Scroll
items.description: Problem → Process → Result as a scroll-driven story: a sticky rail fills as you read and lights the current chapter while chapters rise in with staggered key figures.

items.name: before-after-slider
items.title: Before / After Slider
items.description: Drag, tap or use the arrow keys to wipe between two states. The knob stretches while held, the reveal edge glows and the handle sweeps once on first view.

items.name: career-timeline
items.title: Career Timeline
items.description: A vertical line that draws itself as you scroll with a glowing head; milestone nodes pop on springs and cards slide in from alternating sides.

items.name: skills-marquee
items.title: Skills Marquee
items.description: Two counter-rotating rails of skill pills. Hover or keyboard focus pauses, a visible Pause button covers touch and WCAG 2.2.2, and reduced motion becomes a calm wrapped list.

items.name: skill-meters
items.title: Skill Meters
items.description: Radial gauges that sweep to their value on scroll-in: glowing gradient arc, a comet dot on the tip and a live count-up. Staggered, replayable and exposed as ARIA meters.

items.name: impact-stats
items.title: Impact Stats
items.description: Odometer counters: every digit is a reel spinning to its value on its own spring when the row scrolls in — right-most digits settle last, like a mechanical counter.

items.name: testimonial-carousel
items.title: Testimonial Carousel
items.description: Large display-type quotes sliding on direction-aware springs with swipe/drag, arrow keys and a progress-filled dot for auto-advance. Pauses on hover, focus and drag.

items.name: client-logo-strip
items.title: Client Logo Strip
items.description: A calm trust row of generated marks with a cursor-following spotlight that lights hairline borders; marks lift and spin a few degrees on hover/focus.

items.name: contact-form-card
items.title: Contact Form Card
items.description: Validated on blur and submit with announced inline errors (shake + focus jump), optional async onSubmit with a sending morph, a drawn-check success scene with a particle burst, and a failure state with Retry that keeps everything typed.

items.name: social-dock
items.title: Social Dock
items.description: A floating link dock whose icons swell with a spring as the pointer (or keyboard focus) nears them, with a coloured halo and a springy label chip. Generic glyphs — bring your own.

items.name: copy-email-button
items.title: Copy Email Button
items.description: A pill showing your address: the glyph morphs to a check, the label rolls to “Copied”, a ring pulses out and a live region confirms. Falls back to a select hint if the clipboard is blocked.

items.name: availability-badge
items.title: Availability Badge
items.description: A status pill with a motion language per state: “open” sends two staggered radar ripples, “limited” breathes slowly, “booked” holds still. Copy swaps on a vertical spring; optional live local clock.

items.name: portfolio-footer
items.title: Portfolio Footer
items.description: A closing statement in giant display type — letters rise out of masks on scroll-in and a light follows the cursor across the glyphs — with a slow ribbon marquee, links and back-to-top.

items.name: section-spy-nav
items.title: Section Spy Nav
items.description: Sticky in-page navigation that follows your reading position: a shared pill springs between links as sections cross the reading line, a hairline fills with overall progress, and clicks glide and move focus into the section.

items.name: project-lightbox
items.title: Project Lightbox
items.description: Thumbnails open into a detail modal through a shared-element morph — artwork flies from its tile to the hero slot while copy staggers in. Focus trapped and restored, Esc closes, ←/→ browse.

items.name: intro-preloader
items.title: Intro Preloader
items.description: Greeting words flick by while a big counter climbs 0→100, then the ink curtain lifts with a trailing curve that flattens as it leaves and the page settles from a slight zoom. Skippable.

items.name: reading-progress-toc
items.title: Reading Progress + TOC
items.description: A spring-smoothed reading bar and a sticky table of contents that lights the section on screen, with a live “min left” estimate — made for long-form blog posts.

items.name: resume-download-button
items.title: Résumé Download Button
items.description: The document glyph prints itself line by line, then drops into a tray as the file downloads and the label settles on “Saved”. Live status for screen readers.

items.name: services-cards
items.title: Services Cards
items.description: Four offers in one row: hover or focus a card and it swells while the others yield; a cursor-lit border follows the pointer, the icon tile tilts and deliverables stagger in with ticking checks.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: Scroll Reveal
items.description: A wrapper that animates its content in on scroll: seven effects (rise, fade, blur, scale, clip, slide-left/right), optional child staggering, any scroll container, and a no-motion fallback.

items.name: portfolio-studio-template
items.title: Studio Folio Template
items.description: A complete one-page designer portfolio composed from Framekit parts — intro preloader, kinetic name hero, spy-nav, impact stats, filterable work with lightbox, services, testimonials, contact form and footer. Installing it pulls in every part.

items.name: portfolio-developer-template
items.title: Dev Folio Template
items.description: A developer-flavoured one-pager composed from Framekit parts — terminal hero, skills marquee, hover-preview project index, scroll-drawn career timeline, skill meters, social dock, copy-email + résumé and a statement footer.

items.name: year-activity-grid
items.title: Year Activity Grid
items.description: A contribution calendar that blooms in on a diagonal wave, lights a crosshair of the hovered weekday and week, floats a readout above the day and reports streaks. Fully arrow-key navigable.

items.name: now-playing-widget
items.title: Now Playing Widget
items.description: A vinyl slides out of a generated sleeve and spins as a tonearm settles on it, an EQ breathes beside the title and progress ticks live with a scrubbable seek bar. Visual only — wire it to your own player.

items.name: world-clock-globe
items.title: World Clock Globe
items.description: A dotted planet you can spin, lit by the real sun — the night side dims along a live terminator, a 24-hour ring tracks the chosen city and every card ticks its own local time. Canvas 2D, no map tiles.

items.name: bento-profile-board
items.title: Bento Profile Board
items.description: Your profile as a living dashboard: identity with a pulsing build status, an analogue clock that follows your time zone, weather glyph, now-playing equaliser, visitor odometer, activity strip, stack chips and a CTA — tiles rise in on a stagger and each lights its own border under the cursor.

items.name: scatter-desk-collage
items.title: Scatter Desk Collage
items.description: A desk of rotated polaroids, sticky notes, UI clips, quote cards and a sticker that you can really move — the picked card straightens and lifts, arrow keys nudge, and “Tidy up” snaps everything to a grid on springs.

items.name: kudos-wall
items.title: Kudos Wall
items.description: Praise cards drift past in three columns at different speeds and directions behind a soft fade mask, with underlined key phrases and a cheer toggle on every card. Hover or focus pauses; a Pause button covers touch.

items.name: book-spine-shelf
items.title: Book Spine Shelf
items.description: A shelf of generated book spines: the hovered book slides out while neighbours lean away, and choosing one swings its cover open on a hinge into a reading card with an optional ribbon. Arrow keys walk the shelf.

items.name: mesh-project-cards
items.title: Mesh Project Cards
items.description: Project cards headed by a living mesh gradient — drifting blurred blobs with film grain — and a status pill that pulses for live and in-progress work. Cards tilt toward the pointer with a travelling glare and the whole card is one link.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A Ctrl/⌘ K palette for hopping around a portfolio: fuzzy search that underlines the letters it matched, grouped results, a highlight pill that springs between rows, key-cap hints and full combobox semantics.

items.name: island-section-nav
items.title: Island Section Nav
items.description: A floating pill that tells you where you are — current section with a scroll-progress ring — then swells into a full jump bar on hover, focus or tap with a sliding highlight, and settles back when you leave.

items.name: sticky-card-stack
items.title: Sticky Card Stack
items.description: Project cards that pin one over the next like a deck being dealt — each card shrinks back and dims as the following one slides up over it, still peeking out by a few pixels. Scroll-driven with sticky positioning, no layout JS.

items.name: pinned-project-reel
items.title: Pinned Project Reel
items.description: The section pins to the viewport and your vertical scroll slides a film strip of project cards sideways, with a springy counter and progress line. Focusing a card scrolls the page to it; reduced motion becomes a plain snap scroller.

items.name: scroll-text-fill
items.title: Scroll Text Fill
items.description: A large editorial statement whose words light up one by one as you scroll, each rising a few pixels into place; accent words get a sweeping underline. The full sentence is exposed to screen readers from the start.

items.name: xray-lens-cursor
items.title: X-ray Lens Cursor
items.description: A round lens follows the pointer on a spring and shows a second, perfectly aligned layer of the same content — blueprint, wireframe or annotations — through a clip-path. Press to swell the lens. The reveal is decorative and hidden from assistive tech.

items.name: charm-text
items.title: Charm Text
items.description: A sentence with a few enchanted words. Hover, focus or tap one and it recolours, draws an underline and a tiny glyph pops out on a spring; click pins it on. A chip variant sets glyph pills inline that hop on hover.

items.name: big-type-footer
items.title: Big-Type Footer
items.description: A closing section built around one enormous word whose letters swell and lean toward the cursor, with a ticker, quiet link pills, a live local clock and back-to-top. Light paper / dark ink, never a fixed palette.

items.name: grain-gradient-field
items.title: Grain Gradient Field
items.description: A full-bleed background of four slowly drifting colour blobs under real SVG film grain, with a pointer-following glow. Four palettes, light and dark tuned, still when reduced motion is on.

items.name: theme-reveal-toggle
items.title: Theme Reveal Toggle
items.description: A sky-to-night switch: the sun rolls behind a crescent, clouds give way to stars, and the theme change blooms out of the switch as a circular View Transition reveal. Instant swap under reduced motion.

items.name: mini-desktop-os
items.title: Mini Desktop OS
items.description: A tiny windowed desktop for a portfolio: generated wallpaper, menu bar with a live clock, icon grid, draggable windows with close / minimise / maximise, and a dock. Keyboard-movable; sheets on phones.

items.name: login-gate-intro
items.title: Login Gate Intro
items.description: A lock-screen preloader: oversized clock, generated avatar card, a password field that types itself, a three-step sign-in sequence, then the site fades up. Skip link included; reduced motion opens instantly.

items.name: route-chooser-hero
items.title: Route Chooser Hero
items.description: A fork in the road under a sky that follows your attention: hover or focus the left card and the sun climbs, the right one and the moon rises while a lantern walks that branch. Real buttons or links underneath.

items.name: discovery-scene
items.title: Discovery Scene
items.description: An illustrated desk (night in dark mode, daylight in light) with six hidden sparkles. Each find lights its object — lamp, steam, spinning record — reveals a fact, and counts toward “found 6 / 6”. Plain list and reset included.

items.name: image-lens
items.title: Image Lens
items.description: A glass loupe that follows the pointer and magnifies the image beneath it: the rim refracts and fringes like real glass, the rest of the frame softly desaturates, and pinch, ctrl+wheel or a click change the zoom. Press and hold on touch to lift the lens above your finger. Optional annotations appear only inside the lens.

items.name: signal-beam-diagram
items.title: Signal Beam Diagram
items.description: An integration map where light travels: sources fire gradient pulses along hairline S-curves into a glass hub, which relays them to destinations. Select a node to isolate its route and read what flows through it.

items.name: feature-bento-grid
items.title: Feature Bento Grid
items.description: An asymmetric grid of feature tiles with generated art. Hover or focus a tile: it lifts, a hairline light follows the pointer around its edge, the art drifts up and a call-to-action rises. CTAs stay visible on touch.

items.name: live-feed-stack
items.title: Live Feed Stack
items.description: A notification centre on glass. Alerts drop in at the top on a crisp spring, the list makes room with a layout animation, and older ones fold into a pile you can expand. Times tick; arrivals are announced; the stream can be paused.

items.name: file-tree-explorer
items.title: File Tree Explorer
items.description: An editor-grade file tree: folders open on a soft height spring, hairline guides show depth, and one highlight glides between selected rows. Full WAI-ARIA tree keyboard support with type-ahead; the selected path is announced.

items.name: device-frame
items.title: Device Frame
items.description: Generic, logo-free device chrome for product shots: a browser with a frosted toolbar and centred address field, or a phone with a machined two-tone rim, punch-hole camera, status bar and floating glass tab bar.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping avatars that make room: hover or focus one and it lifts while neighbours part on a spring, revealing a frosted name tag with role and presence. The “+N” chip opens a tidy list of everyone else.

items.name: neon-halo-card
items.title: Neon Halo Card
items.description: A card rimmed by a slow sweep of coloured light: a conic gradient travels a hairline edge while a soft bloom breathes behind it, and the pointer pulls a quiet spotlight across the surface. Restrained on light pages.

items.name: horizon-grid-field
items.title: Horizon Grid Field
items.description: A quiet perspective floor gliding toward you under a softly lit horizon. Hairline grid lines fade into haze, a low glow sits on the vanishing line and, in dark scopes, still stars hang above. Pure CSS 3D.

items.name: flicker-dot-field
items.title: Flicker Dot Field
items.description: A calm LED-like matrix: each mark drifts between brightness levels on its own clock so the field shimmers without syncing, and marks near the pointer glow. Set flicker to 0 for a still dot pattern. Canvas 2D.

items.name: confetti-burst-button
items.title: Confetti Burst Button
items.description: A celebratory primary action: the label rolls to a check while a cone of paper confetti (or your own glyphs) bursts from the button with real drag, gravity and tumble. The canvas exists only while particles do.

items.name: video-lightbox-dialog
items.title: Video Lightbox Dialog
items.description: A cinematic thumbnail with a clear-glass play button that grows into a focused player on a shared-layout spring while the page blurs back. Bring your own video, or use the generated preview with captions.

items.name: word-cycle-text
items.title: Word Cycle Text
items.description: A headline whose key word keeps changing its mind: each word rises letter by letter out of a soft blur inside a tinted capsule that resizes on a spring while the line glides to make room.

items.name: highlight-marker-text
items.title: Highlight Marker Text
items.description: Editorial copy annotated by hand: as it scrolls into view a marker sweeps behind one phrase, an underline draws under the next, a pen circle loops another and a strike crosses one out, in sequence. Wraps across lines.

items.name: velocity-marquee
items.title: Velocity Marquee
items.description: Oversized editorial rails that idle along, then answer your scroll: scroll faster and the rows speed up and lean into the motion; scroll back and they reverse. Solid and outline rows alternate.

items.name: sparkle-text
items.title: Sparkle Text
items.description: A word that catches the light: four-point stars bloom and fade around it on staggered clocks while the letters carry a soft ink-to-accent gradient. Sparkles on scroll-in or hover, then rests.

items.name: glass-app-dock
items.title: Glass App Dock
items.description: A macOS-style dock: icons magnify on a spring with a cosine falloff around the pointer, labels float above, launching bounces the icon and lights a running dot. Keyboard focus magnifies too.

items.name: spotlight-command-palette
items.title: Spotlight Command Palette
items.description: A cmdk-style ⌘K launcher: fuzzy grouped results, a highlight that springs between rows, nested pages (Backspace to go back), key-cap hints and full combobox semantics with focus restore.

items.name: activity-rings
items.title: Activity Rings
items.description: Apple Watch-style concentric progress rings: gradient strokes sweep in on a spring, overshooting 100% laps over itself with a shadowed tip, and the legend numbers roll up.

items.name: glass-mega-navbar
items.title: Glass Mega Navbar
items.description: A full-width bar that contracts into a floating glass pill on scroll. Menus open into one mega panel that slides between sections with a blur, a hover pill glides between triggers, and phones get a disclosure sheet.

items.name: pricing-plans
items.title: Pricing Plans
items.description: Three-tier pricing with a sliding monthly/yearly switch whose numerals roll digit by digit, a highlighted ink plan with a light rim, and a “you save” chip that springs in on yearly.

items.name: faq-accordion
items.title: FAQ Accordion
items.description: A two-column FAQ: rows expand on a height spring, the plus rotates into a cross, the open row lifts onto a soft surface and answers un-blur in. ↑ ↓ Home End move between questions.

items.name: testimonial-wall
items.title: Testimonial Wall
items.description: A masonry wall of quote cards whose columns drift in opposite directions at different speeds, faded at the edges, with a pause button; reduced motion shows a static scrollable wall.

items.name: feature-comparison-table
items.title: Feature Comparison Table
items.description: A plan comparison table with a sticky header, collapsible groups, a tinted highlighted column, row hover and a one-plan-at-a-time switcher on phones. Real table semantics with screen-reader labels for ticks.

items.name: cta-glow-banner
items.title: CTA Glow Banner
items.description: A closing call-to-action on an ink panel: a soft lilac and orange aurora trails the pointer behind a fine dot grid, the block rises in on scroll and the arrow nudges on hover.

items.name: newsletter-signup
items.title: Newsletter Signup
items.description: An inline email capture with inline validation, a button that morphs to a spinner, a shake on error, a polite live region and a success state with undo.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site Footer
items.description: A calm SaaS footer: link columns with sliding hairline underlines, a live status pill, socials, a language picker and a giant outlined wordmark that rises from the bottom edge.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie Consent
items.description: A floating glass consent card with equal-weight Accept / Reject (no dark patterns) and a Customise drawer of per-category switches that expands in place, plus a chip to reopen settings.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement Bar
items.description: A slim ink top bar with a sweeping sheen; messages roll vertically with a blur, dots pick one, hover or focus pauses, and dismissing collapses the height smoothly.

items.name: changelog-timeline
items.title: Changelog Timeline
items.description: Release notes on a timeline with sticky dates, popping dots, generated cover art and a filter (All / New / Improved / Fixed) that re-flows each change list on springs.

items.name: scroll-product-reveal
items.title: Scroll Product Reveal
items.description: An Apple-style pinned product story: scroll scrubs a CSS 3D device through rotation, screen glow and an exploded-layer view while chapter copy cross-fades with a blur. Scrolls inside its own focusable frame.

items.name: app-store-expand-card
items.title: App Store Expand Card
items.description: Story cards that grow into a full detail sheet with a shared-layout spring: art, headline and surface morph from the card, the body rises in behind. Esc or close collapses it and returns focus.

items.name: liquid-glass-tab-bar
items.title: Liquid Glass Tab Bar
items.description: An iOS 26-style floating glass tab bar: a refractive lens slides between tabs and stretches with distance like liquid, icons pop on select, plus a floating accessory button.

items.name: gradient-mesh-hero
items.title: Gradient Mesh Hero
items.description: A hero over four soft colour fields that drift on slow offset orbits and lean toward the pointer, with fine grain, a glass eyebrow pill and a blur-staggered headline.

items.name: morph-button-modal
items.title: Morph Button Modal
items.description: A pill button that physically becomes its dialog: the surface expands on a shared-layout spring, the label blurs into a form, and submit shrinks it back into a success pill. Focus trapped and restored.

items.name: kinetic-stats-band
items.title: Kinetic Stats Band
items.description: A band of big tabular numbers that count up on an expo curve when scrolled into view, with motion blur on the fast part and sparklines that draw themselves.

items.name: parallax-depth-stack
items.title: Parallax Depth Stack
items.description: A fanned card stack on CSS 3D layers: the pointer tilts it and each layer parallaxes by depth with a moving sheen; click or Enter sends the front card to the back on a spring.

items.name: spring-stagger-grid
items.title: Spring Stagger Grid
items.description: A filterable tile grid that enters on a diagonal ripple (delay = row + column), re-flows on layout springs when filtered and exits with a quick scale-down.

items.name: magnetic-dot-grid
items.title: Magnetic Dot Grid
items.description: A canvas field of dots that lean toward the pointer on spring physics, swell and tint near it, then settle with a soft wobble; clicks send a ripple. Theme-aware, static on reduced motion.

items.name: page-curtain-transition
items.title: Page Curtain Transition
items.description: Route changes play a staggered column curtain: panels sweep up to cover, the next page name flashes on the curtain, then they lift away to reveal it. Reduced motion cross-fades.

items.name: lit-product-card-3d
items.title: Lit Product Card 3D
items.description: A product card with real lighting: tilt follows the pointer, a specular highlight tracks the light while the cast shadow moves opposite, the product floats on its own Z layer and swatches recolour on a spring.

items.name: timeline-scrubber
items.title: Timeline Scrubber
items.description: A media scrubber with a waveform that lights up behind the playhead, a thumb that grows while dragging, chapter markers that snap within 1.5 s, a time bubble and full slider keyboard support.

items.name: spring-reorder-list
items.title: Spring Reorder List
items.description: A priority list reordered by dragging the grip: the lifted row scales and deepens its shadow while siblings part on springs. Keyboard ↑ ↓ on a grip moves rows with live announcements.

items.name: blur-cascade-heading
items.title: Blur Cascade Heading
items.description: A keynote-style display headline that resolves out of focus: words or letters rise through a mask from blur to sharp on springs, and highlight words land last in a gradient.

items.name: glass-segmented-control
items.title: Glass Segmented Control
items.description: An iOS-style segmented control whose selected thumb is a lifted glass pill that springs between segments with a press squish — native radio semantics, arrow keys and an opaque reduced-transparency fallback.

items.name: dynamic-status-island
items.title: Dynamic Status Island
items.description: A black capsule that morphs its silhouette between live activities — recording with a level meter, a focus timer with pause, an upload with a progress hairline, a success tick — size and radius on one crisp spring while content cross-fades with a little blur.

items.name: detent-sheet
items.title: Detent Sheet
items.description: An Apple-style bottom sheet resting at peek, half and full detents — velocity-aware drag with rubber-banding, the background recedes and dims as it rises, and a grabber that also works with tap and ↑ ↓. Esc closes and focus returns to the trigger.

items.name: vibrancy-context-menu
items.title: Vibrancy Context Menu
items.description: A macOS-grade context menu on regular glass that blooms from the exact pointer position, flips near the edges, glides a highlight capsule between rows, and blinks the chosen item once before dissolving.

items.name: deploy-timeline
items.title: Deploy Timeline
items.description: A build pipeline that reads like a calm status page: dots resolve to spinners to ticks, the rail fills as steps complete, elapsed times tick in tabular figures, each row expands into logs, and failures stop the rail in rose with a one-click retry.

items.name: usage-quota-meter
items.title: Usage Quota Meter
items.description: A billing-period usage card: hairline tracks fill with stacked segments on the house ease, figures count up in tabular numerals, a limit tick marks 100%, and bars go amber near the limit and rose when exceeded — always with a text label.

items.name: onboarding-stepper
items.title: Onboarding Stepper
items.description: A three-question setup flow on one continuous surface: a progress capsule stretches into the current step with a shared-layout spring, panels slide in the direction of travel, validation speaks inline, and the finish holds its label with a spinner before landing on a tick.

items.name: sortable-data-table
items.title: Sortable Data Table
items.description: A dense, quiet deployments table: sortable headers with aria-sort, search and status filter chips, rows that glide to their new order, hairline hover and selected tints, a bulk-action bar that springs up on selection, and designed loading and empty states.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: A calendar that previews the range as you hover with a continuous tinted band between endpoint pills, month pages that slide in the direction you move, preset chips, full grid keyboard support and a live summary.

items.name: feedback-state-panel
items.title: Feedback State Panel
items.description: One surface for the screens nobody designs — empty, error, offline, permission and success — each with its own glyph and motion character, copy that names the next step, and a primary action with a real loading → success / error loop.

items.name: kbd-shortcut-hint
items.title: Keyboard Shortcut Hint
items.description: A cheat sheet of tactile keycaps that knows your platform (⌘ ⌥ ⇧ vs Ctrl Alt Shift); hold real keys and matching caps sink and light up, complete a combo and its row confirms. Exports Kbd for inline hints.

items.name: inset-settings-list
items.title: Inset Settings List
items.description: An iOS-style grouped inset list with tinted icon tiles, hairlines inset to the label edge, switches whose knob stretches on press, and choice rows that push a detail page with a parallax slide and return focus on Back.

items.name: rolling-number-stepper
items.title: Rolling Number Stepper
items.description: A quantity field whose changed digits roll in the direction of travel, accelerates on press-and-hold like a hardware stepper, and nudges sideways with a reason at its bounds. A real spinbutton you can type into.

items.name: file-drop-uploader
items.title: File Drop Uploader
items.description: A calm dropzone that lifts and tints on drag-over, then gives each file its own row with a spring progress hairline, a tick that pops on completion, and errors that say what went wrong with one-tap retry.

items.name: glow-candle-card
items.title: Glow Candle Card
items.description: An ink “Sales Report” card with monospaced rolling numerals, a neon delta and a glowing candlestick chart: candles grow from their midpoints, new ones stream in live and a crosshair shows OHLC on hover or ← →.

items.name: glow-level-card
items.title: Glow Level Card
items.description: The ink stat card with segmented neon level meters: segments light left to right with a bloom, levels re-balance live, and hovering or focusing a row reveals its channel and share.

items.name: glow-histogram-card
items.title: Glow Histogram Card
items.description: A neon gradient histogram beside the ink stat card: bars rise on a soft spring with glowing caps that fade into the card, values drift live and hover / ← → lifts a bar with its value.

items.name: budget-area-card
items.title: Budget Area Card
items.description: A soft white squircle with a big rolling total, a delta pill and floating soft-3D banknotes. An indigo stepped area chart draws itself in with drifting sparkles and an end arrow, and a tooltip bubble springs between points.

items.name: pastel-object-carousel
items.title: Pastel Object Carousel
items.description: A cover-flow of pastel portrait cards with floating caption panels. A heavily damped spring carries drags; neighbours tuck behind at 85%, and each layered CSS-3D object (coins, calendar, key, lock, card) turns on Y with its card’s position.

items.name: sparkline-kpi-tile
items.title: Sparkline KPI Tile
items.description: A compact metric tile with a live dot, rolling numerals, a delta chip and a smooth sparkline that draws in, streams new points and shows a crosshair value on hover or ← →.

items.name: spend-donut-card
items.title: Spend Donut Card
items.description: A radial spend breakdown whose rounded arcs sweep in one after another; hovering or focusing a category pops its arc outward and rolls the centre total to that amount.

items.name: contribution-heatmap-tile
items.title: Contribution Heatmap Tile
items.description: A weeks × days activity heatmap: cells pop in on a diagonal wave, the total and streak roll up, and the grid is one roving tab stop where arrows move a ring that announces the day.

items.name: wallet-balance-card
items.title: Wallet Balance Card
items.description: A fanned stack of payment cards: picking one springs it to the front while the rest tuck behind, the balance rolls to the new amount and an eye toggle blurs the figures.

items.name: crypto-ticker-row
items.title: Crypto Ticker Row
items.description: A watchlist with live prices: each tick flashes the price green or red and fades back, mini sparklines morph to the new history and every row is a labelled button.

items.name: goal-progress-card
items.title: Goal Progress Card
items.description: A savings goal with a liquid progress bar: topping up springs the fill forward under a moving sheen, milestone ticks light as they pass and reaching the goal morphs the button into a check.

items.name: comparison-bar-card
items.title: Comparison Bar Card
items.description: This period vs last as paired bars: a segmented control slides a pill between Week, Month and Year while bars re-grow on a spring, and hovering or focusing a pair lifts it with both values.

items.name: smart-widget-stack
items.title: Smart Widget Stack
items.description: An iOS-style widget stack: the top widget sits at full size with the next ones peeking above; scroll, swipe vertically, use ↑ ↓ or the side dots to flip through on a damped spring while content re-animates on arrival.
